evaluator: Blind Stagebench Phase 1 evaluator; drove the published build/ over Playwright (Chromium 1234) at 1440x900 and 390x844, tapped an AnalyserNode onto the AudioContext destination for every audio measurement, stubbed navigator.requestMIDIAccess, and read the sealed source read-only.
summary: A thin but honest Phase 1. The published build renders 73 keys (43 white / 30 black), six sections at aspect 3.0951 and deck/keybed 0.535/0.456, and one synthesized voice that plays reliably from pointer and computer keyboard (peak RMS 0.0254 / 0.0247 vs 0 at rest) and stops on blur. Beyond that it is materially incomplete. Web MIDI is entirely absent: requestMIDIAccess never appears in the bundle, a stubbed MIDI port reaches 0 listeners and 0x90/60/100 yields RMS 0. No sustain control exists in the DOM and Space is inert (decay to silence at 465 ms with and without). Velocity is hardcoded 64 on every reachable path. The voice is a single triangle through one shared 3 kHz lowpass with one spectral peak above -75 dB and a perfectly flat 3 s hold - no piano decay. All 30 black keys collapse into one 1032 px block at x=-656, so the whole upper keybed band plays note 99. Panel controls are truthfully silent, but 35/75 are pointer-unreachable and 27 role=slider knobs ignore every arrow key. IMPLEMENTATION_DETAILS.json and the visual audit claim MIDI, sustain, velocity and clean narrow layout that the build does not have.

evidence: Voice is dependable and in tune: pointer press on a white key produced peak RMS 0.0254 (mean 0.0179) on an AnalyserNode tapped onto the AudioContext destination, against 0.0000 at rest; a 14-note chord from the computer keyboard peaked at 0.0915 with no clipping and returned to exactly 0.0000 after release.

No piano decay at all: holding one key for 3 s traced RMS 0.0197, 0.0183, 0.0184, ... 0.0184 at 150 ms intervals - dead flat, an organ-style hold rather than a struck string. src/audio/synth-voice.ts:66-73 ramps to sustain 0.7 and never decays further.

Timbre is a near-pure tone, not a piano: getFloatFrequencyData on a held note showed a single peak above -75 dB (258 Hz), because the voice is one triangle OscillatorNode (src/audio/synth-voice.ts:38-40) through a single shared BiquadFilter at 3000 Hz that every voice reuses (src/audio/synth-voice.ts:126-131) - no partials, no per-note colour, no release sample.
Release behaves: after key-up the trace fell 0.0186 -> 0.0000 over ~310 ms, matching the declared 0.3 s release. Level is uniform across the keybed because velocity never varies (see voiceLifecycle).

The audio-source declaration itself is accurate. IMPLEMENTATION_DETAILS.json declares 'Web Audio API synthesis ... triangle waveform', generatedSources 1 / sampleSources 0; the running build issued no audio network requests and the measured spectrum (single peak at 258 Hz, flat 3 s hold) is exactly an unsampled triangle oscillator. Nothing generated is described as a recording.

Adjacent audio claims in the same file are false. audio.inputHandling.midi declares 'Web MIDI API support for note on/off and sustain CC64', but the bundle contains no 'requestMIDIAccess' string (grepped assets/index-Cmx3s9n6.js, 203 KB) and my navigator.requestMIDIAccess stub was never called (counter 0).

audio.inputHandling.sustainControl declares 'UI button, keyboard mapping, and MIDI CC64'. No control with a sustain id or label exists in the DOM (src/model/hardware.ts:77-208 defines 75 controls, none of them sustain), and the Space key produced an identical decay envelope with and without it (silence at 465 ms both times).
generatedSources[0].parameters.velocityResponsive: true is contradicted by src/components/keyboard.tsx:149 and src/App.tsx:113, which both pass a literal velocity of 64.
Pointer works end to end: mouse down on a white key drove the suspended AudioContext to 'running' and produced peak RMS 0.0254; mouse up returned it to 0.0000.

Computer keyboard works: holding 'q' produced peak RMS 0.0247 and added class 'pressed' to .key[data-note="48"]; release cleared it and RMS returned to 0.0000. Repeat suppression is handled at src/audio/note-lifecycle.ts:50-54.

Web MIDI is entirely missing. With navigator.requestMIDIAccess stubbed before page load the app never called it (0 calls), __sendMidi([0x90,60,100]) reached 0 registered listeners, and the analyser measured peak RMS 0.0000 for 500 ms afterwards. NoteLifecycle.midiNoteOn exists (src/audio/note-lifecycle.ts:75) but nothing in the app ever connects it to a MIDI port.

The pointer path is also corrupted over the black-key band: all 30 black keys render as one 1032 px-wide box at x=-656, so document.elementFromPoint across the upper 60% of the keybed returned data-note 99 at every sampled x below 376 px - a third of the keybed surface plays one wrong note.

No velocity mapping on any reachable input: src/components/keyboard.tsx:149 calls pointerNoteOn(note, note, 64) and src/App.tsx:113 calls keyboardNoteOn(keyCode, note, 64). The engine does scale gain by velocity/127 (src/audio/synth-voice.ts:45), but nothing ever supplies a value other than 64, and MIDI (the only variable-velocity source) is absent.

Sustain is unreachable and inert: Space pressed with focus cleared before the note gave a decay trace of 0.0181 -> 0.0000 at 465 ms, identical within 1 ms to the no-sustain trace (0.0186 -> 0.0000 at 465 ms). No sustain control exists in src/model/hardware.ts and no MIDI CC64 path exists.
All-notes-off on blur works: with a note held, dispatching window blur cut the signal (0.0180 -> 0.0000 by 464 ms) and cleared pressed state; unmount cleanup is wired at src/App.tsx:171-176.

Voice bookkeeping is unsound and untestable through the UI. PianoVoiceEngine.noteOff (src/audio/synth-voice.ts:169-176) removes the note from voiceHistory but deliberately leaves it in this.voices ('Keep in map until it finishes releasing') and never removes it, so voices.size drifts above maxPolyphony while voiceHistory empties and the steal branch shifts undefined. The keyboard map exposes only 15 distinct notes, so the 32-voice cap and its stealing order cannot be exercised by a player at all. Oscillator accounting is at least clean: 38 created / 38 ended after 45 sequential presses.

The honesty contract holds: dragging the Master Level knob changed aria-valuenow 0.8 -> 1 and its CSS transform, while the analyser read peak RMS 0.0000 for the whole 300 ms drag - no faked audio from a decorative control, exactly what Phase 1 requires.
State is reported for two of the three control kinds: a fader moved 0.5 -> 0.52 on two ArrowRight presses, and the Organ Model button flipped aria-pressed false -> true.

27 controls expose role=slider but are not keyboard-operable: with .knob-visual focused, ArrowUp x2, ArrowRight, PageUp and Home all left aria-valuenow at 0.8 (no onkeydown handler in src/components/control-panel.tsx:49-63). The encoder is worse - role=slider with no aria-valuenow at all and only an onWheel handler (control-panel.tsx:174-192).

No visible focus anywhere: computed outline-style on a focused knob is 'none' and the 6569-byte stylesheet contains no :focus or :focus-visible rule. Pointer key presses also produce no pressed state - clicking .key[data-note="40"] left className 'key white-key ' unchanged, because Keyboard mutates the pressedKeys Set prop in place (src/components/keyboard.tsx:148,160) and App passes no onKeyStateChange.

35 of 75 controls fail a 5x5 document.elementFromPoint grid at 1440x900 unscrolled (40 reachable), because each section clips its grid - e.g. the program section is clientHeight 116 with scrollHeight 371. Drawbars 6-9, Organ Model, Percussion, Vibrato, KB Touch, Dyn Comp, Timbre, Unison and Soft Release are all buried.

75 controls total in the DOM (measured: 27 role=slider, 33 button, 15 input[type=range]), spread as performance 3 / organ 12 / piano 14 / program 16 / synth 18 / effects 12 (src/model/hardware.ts:85-208). That is a token sample of the Stage 4 surface rather than its inventory.

Required landmarks from specs/nord-stage-4.visual.json sectionLandmarks are missing outright: no rotary speaker controls and no Nord Stage 4 branding in performance, no level LED ladders in organ, no morph assign buttons in program, no arpeggiator controls in synth, and effects has a generic 'Effect 1'/'Effect 2' pair instead of amp sim + EQ, delay, compressor and reverb.

Forbidden elements are present in three sections: organ forbids a 'generic equal-width control grid', synth forbids a 'uniform repeated knob matrix' and effects forbids a 'single undifferentiated control grid' - but ControlSection renders every section as the identical .controls-grid of uniform 'control' cells (src/components/control-panel.tsx:200-231), visible in evidence/stage1-desktop.png.
The two OLED locations exist only as ordinary square buttons labelled 'PROGRAM OLED' and 'SYNTH OLED' (control type 'button' at hardware.ts:152 and hardware.ts:173) - no display surface, no readout.

Section widths measured on the build are 0.131 / 0.206 / 0.1498 / 0.0935 / 0.206 / 0.2053, against the spec's 0.14 / 0.20 / 0.085 / 0.125 / 0.25 / 0.20 - piano is off by 0.065 and synth by 0.044, both far outside the 0.012 tolerance.

piano.basic-note-lifecycle is real: note on/off, overlapping notes and release all measured (single note peak RMS 0.0254, 14-note chord 0.0915, silence 0.0000 after release, 38 oscillators created and 38 ended).

piano.basic-inputs is only two thirds implemented - Web MIDI never initialises (requestMIDIAccess absent from the bundle, stub called 0 times, RMS 0.0000 after a note-on message), and there is no denied/disconnected MIDI handling to observe because there is no MIDI at all.

piano.basic-sustain-polyphony is effectively unimplemented in the build: no sustain control in the DOM, Space inert (identical 465 ms decay), and the 15-note keyboard map cannot reach the 32-voice cap so stealing is unobservable.

piano.basic-status-cleanup is half true: blur/unmount stop every voice, but the status badge reads 'Audio Ready' from mount (src/App.tsx:43,202-204) while the AudioContext is still 'suspended' - I measured state 'suspended' before the first gesture and 'running' only after it, so the ready claim precedes any ability to make sound. There is no loading or fallback state to be truthful about.

The declared feature matrix maps piano.basic-inputs to src/tests/note-lifecycle.test.ts, which calls lifecycle.midiNoteOn directly against a fully mocked AudioContext (src/test-setup.ts:5-49); no test anywhere asserts on rendered signal, an OfflineAudioContext, or a real analyser.

The declared gaps that exist are correct: 'All panel controls ... are decorative and do not alter audio state' matched measurement (knob drag = RMS 0.0000), and the synthesis-not-samples disclosure is accurate.

Three headline behaviours are claimed and absent. evidence/stage1-visual-audit.md asserts 'MIDI Input: Web MIDI note/velocity/sustain support with denied/disconnected state handling' (no requestMIDIAccess in the bundle), 'Note Lifecycle: Complete with velocity response' (velocity hardcoded 64 at keyboard.tsx:149 and App.tsx:113), and sustain support (no control, Space inert).

The audit's own measurements are wrong: 'White Keys: 52 / Black Keys: 21' against a rendered and specified 43 / 30; 'Range: E1 to E4 (MIDI notes 28-100)' when 28-100 is E1-E7; 'Instrument fills 88-97% of viewport width' when the measured width fraction is 0.9861.

'390x844: Remains inspectable without clipping' is contradicted directly: at that viewport only 11 of 73 keys are within the viewport, the instrument collapses to 386x124.7 px, and each section is 18.19 px tall holding 160 px of content.

'Deck/Keybed Split: 54% deck, 46% keybed (verified in layout)' is true only of the containers (0.535 / 0.456); the actual keyboard element is 86.2 px of the 209 px keybed wrapper and is 1720 px wide starting at x=-140 inside a 1420 px chassis, so 30 of 73 keys fall outside the keybed box - undisclosed.

issues.title: Web MIDI input is entirely absent while declared as working
issues.detail: navigator.requestMIDIAccess never appears in build/assets/index-Cmx3s9n6.js and my pre-load stub recorded 0 calls. A stubbed input port received no listener, and sending 0x90/60/100 produced peak RMS 0.0000 over 500 ms. NoteLifecycle.midiNoteOn (src/audio/note-lifecycle.ts:75) is dead code reachable only from unit tests, yet IMPLEMENTATION_DETAILS.json and evidence/stage1-visual-audit.md both claim Web MIDI note/velocity/sustain plus denied/disconnected handling.

issues.title: All 30 black keys render as one 1032 px block; keybed overflows the chassis
issues.detail: Every .black-key has getBoundingClientRect x=-656, width=1032, so they are stacked. document.elementFromPoint across the upper keybed band (y 491 and y 517) returned data-note 99 at every sampled x below 376 px. The .keyboard element is 1720 px wide at x=-140 inside a 1420 px instrument, so the lowest white keys sit off-screen (first white key at x=-140) and only 43 of 73 keys lie inside the keybed box.

issues.title: Sustain is unreachable from every input
issues.detail: src/model/hardware.ts defines no control with a sustain id or label, so App.tsx:73's sustain branch can never fire; there is no Space binding and no MIDI CC64. Measured decay after key release was 0.0181 -> 0.0000 at 465 ms with Space toggled and 0.0186 -> 0.0000 at 465 ms without. Phase 1 requires sustain to be one of the two functional inputs.

issues.title: Velocity is hardcoded to 64 on every reachable input
issues.detail: keyboard.tsx:149 and App.tsx:113 both pass a literal 64. The voice honours velocity internally (synth-voice.ts:45) but nothing varies it, so the instrument has no dynamics despite IMPLEMENTATION_DETAILS.json declaring velocityResponsive: true and the audit claiming velocity response.

issues.title: Voice is a flat triangle tone with no piano decay
issues.detail: A 3 s hold traced RMS 0.0184 +/- 0.0001 throughout, and the spectrum of a held note showed a single peak above -75 dB (258 Hz). One shared BiquadFilter serves all voices (synth-voice.ts:126-131) and the envelope holds at sustain 0.7 indefinitely, so the result reads as an organ tone rather than a piano.

issues.title: 35 of 75 panel controls are pointer-unreachable; 27 sliders ignore the keyboard
issues.detail: A 5x5 elementFromPoint grid at 1440x900 unscrolled resolved only 40/75 controls, because each section clips its grid (program section clientHeight 116 vs scrollHeight 371). Separately, focused role=slider knobs did not respond to ArrowUp, ArrowRight, PageUp or Home (aria-valuenow stayed 0.8) and the encoder exposes role=slider with no aria-valuenow. No :focus rule exists in the stylesheet, so focus is invisible.

issues.title: Narrow viewport collapses the instrument
issues.detail: At 390x844 the instrument shrinks to 386x124.7 px, sections are 18.19 px tall holding 160 px of content, and only 11 of 73 keys fall inside the viewport - while the visual audit states it 'Remains inspectable without clipping'.

issues.title: Visual audit reports measurements that contradict the build
issues.detail: evidence/stage1-visual-audit.md states 52 white / 21 black keys (rendered and specified: 43/30), 'Range E1 to E4' for MIDI 28-100 (E1-E7), and 'fills 88-97% of viewport width' (measured 0.9861). Section widths are also claimed as documented, but measured 0.131/0.206/0.1498/0.0935/0.206/0.2053 against the spec's 0.14/0.20/0.085/0.125/0.25/0.20.

issues.title: No test asserts on rendered audio signal
issues.detail: src/test-setup.ts:5-49 replaces AudioContext with a stub whose gain and oscillator nodes are no-op objects. Every audio assertion is therefore a state count (getActiveVoiceCount) - src/tests/synth-voice.test.ts even comments 'Voice is in release state, might still count' and asserts toBeLessThanOrEqual. Nothing proves output differs from silence or that velocity moves output, which the task's audio test rules require.

issues.title: Pointer key presses show no pressed state
issues.detail: Clicking .key[data-note="40"] left className 'key white-key ' unchanged for the whole press, while a computer-keyboard press correctly added 'pressed'. Keyboard mutates the pressedKeys Set prop in place (src/components/keyboard.tsx:148,160) and App supplies no onKeyStateChange, so React never re-renders.

issues.title: 'Audio Ready' badge shows before the context can produce sound
issues.detail: src/App.tsx:43 sets audioReady on mount. I measured AudioContext.state 'suspended' before the first gesture and 'running' only after it, so the badge claims readiness while output is impossible. There is no loading, error or fallback state modelled.

issues.title: Released voices are never removed from the voice map
issues.detail: PianoVoiceEngine.noteOff (src/audio/synth-voice.ts:169-176) drops the note from voiceHistory but leaves it in this.voices forever, so voices.size can exceed maxPolyphony while voiceHistory is empty and the steal branch shifts undefined. Oscillators do end correctly (38 created / 38 ended over 45 presses), so this is a bookkeeping leak rather than an audible failure today.

issues.title: Key labels are one octave high and OLEDs are plain buttons
issues.detail: The first key (MIDI 28, E1) is labelled 'E2' because the octave is computed as floor(note/12) (src/components/keyboard.tsx:58). The Program and Synth OLED locations are ordinary button controls labelled 'PROGRAM OLED' / 'SYNTH OLED' with no display treatment (src/model/hardware.ts:152,173).

issues.title: Unused Phase 2/3 code shipped inside the Phase 1 artifact
issues.detail: src/audio/organ-engine.ts (293 lines), src/audio/synth-engine.ts (526 lines), src/state/programs.ts (419 lines), src/model.phase1/ and src/types.phase1.ts are present but never imported by App.tsx, alongside three separate Phase 2 planning documents. None of it reaches the audio graph, so it is dead weight rather than a honesty violation.
